company.description: Master record of a prospect/customer account. Territory is derived from `region`.

fields.name: annual_revenue_usd
fields.description: Derived: employees x industry revenue-per-employee x noise

fields.name: region
fields.description: Sales region used for territory routing ('Other' = no territory map)

fields.name: account_status
fields.description: Derived: 'customer' if the company has >= 1 Closed Won opportunity, else 'prospect'

contact.description: Person at a company. Duplicates are merged (never deleted) via merged_into_contact_id.

fields.name: seniority
fields.description: Seniority tier used by FIT scoring

fields.name: merged_into_contact_id
fields.description: Canonical contact when de-duplication merged this record
fields.rule: canonical record must be earlier and active

campaign.description: Marketing campaign / programme that sources leads.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Derived from dates vs. as-of date

sales_rep.description: Sales representative (SDR/AE/Manager) or the Sales-Ops routing queue (REP-000).

fields.name: active_from
fields.description: Effective date from which the rep can receive leads

rep_product.description: Bridge: which products a rep specialises in (SalesRep N:M Product).

lead.description: A sales lead generated from a contact + source, scored, routed and tracked to an outcome.
lead.lifecycle: New -> Working -> Qualified -> Converted | Disqualified | Stale (Stale -> Working re-engaged)

fields.name: campaign_id
fields.description: Primary (first-touch) campaign; null for direct leads

fields.name: source
fields.description: Lead source = campaign channel or 'Direct / Website'

fields.name: consent_status
fields.description: Derived from Consent events at the as-of date (e-mail channel)

fields.name: territory
fields.description: Territory snapshot = company.region at routing time

fields.name: score
fields.description: Derived lead score (0-100) = fit + intent + engagement via ScoreRule

fields.name: scored_ts
fields.description: Score cut-off: only inbound activity <= this time may feed the score

fields.name: duplicate_of_lead_id
fields.description: Canonical lead when this lead was merged by de-duplication
fields.rule: canonical lead created earlier; status = Disqualified (Duplicate)

lead_campaign.description: Bridge: every campaign touch that influenced a lead (Lead N:M Campaign).

consent.description: Append-only consent ledger. The latest applicable event per channel governs outreach.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the consent decision was captured

score_rule.description: Transparent scoring rule table (fit/intent/engagement weights, caps and band cut-offs), effective-dated and versioned.

fields.name: feature
fields.description: Feature the rule reads (attribute, act:<type>, days_since_last_inbound)

activity.description: Immutable engagement / outreach event on a lead.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: Task that triggered an outbound activity

task.description: Follow-up task created from routing + score band, with SLA.
task.lifecycle: open -> completed | overdue | cancelled; suppressed at creation

fields.name: priority
fields.description: P1 = Hot, P2 = Warm, P3 = Cold

fields.name: due_ts
fields.rule: == created_ts + sla_hours (+ offset for later steps)

fields.name: sla_hours
fields.description: SLA for the task's priority band

fields.name: status
fields.rule: suppressed = no consent at creation, cancelled = opt-out/duplicate before completion

opportunity.description: Sales opportunity created from a converted lead.
opportunity.lifecycle: Qualified -> Discovery -> Proposal -> Negotiation -> Closed Won | Closed Lost

fields.name: unit_price_usd
fields.description: List price per seat per year

fields.name: amount_usd
fields.description: Derived: seats x unit_price x (1 - discount/100)
fields.rule: reconciles to seats x unit_price x (1-discount)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Derived from stage: open / won / lost

fields.name: won_lost_reason
fields.rule: required iff closed; reason family must match won/lost

stage_history.description: Append-only stage transition ledger for opportunities.

fields.name: from_stage
fields.description: Previous stage (null for the first record)

lead_status_history.description: Append-only lead lifecycle ledger (state changes are never overwritten).
